items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: But that's what the Loch Lomond though, I remember doing that, I think.

ctx.x: And my Nara Ucha take a steamboat? Do you remember that? Maybe that one. Maybe that one. And the Land of the Yamo Yamo? I don't remember about that one. They're real funny. You know, they're all Wingy's job. You know how Wingy was. Yeah, yeah, yeah. That's what I mean.
But that's what the Loch Lomond though, I remember doing that, I think. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. That's the one that...
You can't buy those records anymore? Yeah, I got something along by my house, I think. Yeah? I think, I believe. I think, yeah. Well, who was in Wingy's band?
